history: Generated 2026-11-22 for the first Brassworks build, one generation per slot. The frame and corner serve both brightness modes; the texture and the scenery have a day version (artDay). Each prompt was sent with one line ahead of it asking for a single image saved under a working name. None of the earlier versions named here was published. Corner: v1 (porthole-flange-corner-v1.webp) had a plain green glass dome that could pass for a lamp or a push button; v2 (porthole-window-corner-v2.webp) showed a bank of cylinders behind a recessed pane; v3 shows a meshed gear train behind the pane, because the theme was meant to carry cogs and gears as well as pipes. Two generations of the v3 prompt were made; the one kept has pipes of equal thickness on both arms, which the other did not. Backdrops: engine-hall-v1.webp and drawing-office-v1.webp had pipes and boilers only; the v2 pair were generated once each from the same prompts with a gear train added (great spur gears beside the engine by night; gear drawings, a geared engine model and loose gears on the table by day).
